title: I want you to … · I told you to …

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения, начинающиеся с I want you … / I don’t want you … / Do you want me …?

answers: I want you to come with me.
I want you to listen carefully.
I don’t want you to be angry.
Do you want me to wait for you?
I don’t want you to call me tonight.
I want you to meet Sarah.

exercises.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки и закончите предложения.

answers: me to go to the cinema

parts: I wanted to get to the station. A woman told
answers: me to turn left after the bridge
him to go to the doctor

parts: Laura had a lot of luggage. She asked
answers: me to help her

parts: I was too busy to talk to Tom. I told
answers: him to come back in ten minutes

parts: I wanted to make a phone call. Paul let
answers: me use his phone

parts: Sue is going to call me later. I told
answers: her not to phone before 8 o’clock
her not to call before 8 o’clock
her not to call me before 8 o’clock
her to play the piano

exercises.instruction: Заполните пропуски, используя глаголы из рамки. В некоторых предложениях необходимо использовать to (to go / to wait и т. д.); в других предложениях to не используется (go/wait и т. д.).

parts: Please stay here. I don’t want you
answers: to go

parts: I didn’t hear what she said, so I asked her
answers: to repeat
wait

parts: Are they already here? I expected them
answers: to arrive
to get

parts: I want to stay here. You can’t make me
answers: go

parts: ‘Is that your bike?’ ‘No, it’s John’s. He let me
answers: borrow

parts: Rachel can’t come to the party. She told me
answers: to tell

parts: Would you like a drink? Would you like me
answers: to make
to get
think

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (заканчивать работу = finish work)

items.prompt: Я хочу, чтобы вы пришли на вечеринку.
answers: I want you to come to the party.

items.prompt: Мы не ожидали, что фильм нам понравится.
answers: We didn’t expect to enjoy the film.
We didn’t expect to like the film.
We did not expect to enjoy the film.
We did not expect to like the film.
Boris persuaded his friend to help him.

items.prompt: Ты хочешь, чтобы я приготовил ужин?
answers: Would you like me to cook dinner?
Do you want me to cook dinner?

items.prompt: Давай поедем в отпуск в Испанию.
answers: Let’s go on holiday to Spain.
Who is teaching you to drive?
Who is teaching you to drive a car?

items.prompt: Гари попросил детей не разговаривать в библиотеке.
answers: Gary told the children not to talk in the library.
Gary told the children not to chat in the library.

items.prompt: Мой начальник разрешает мне заканчивать работу рано по пятницам.
answers: My manager lets me finish work early on Fridays.

items.prompt: Этот фильм всегда заставляет меня плакать.
answers: This film always makes me cry.
